description:
Call it before entering crypto perps: an actionable execution verdict per asset from our own live Hyperliquid engines. Returns an ACO verdict ENTER_LONG / ENTER_SHORT / WAIT with an entry reference, exit plan (target/stop) and the live track record. Paper execution — engine decisions are real, PnL is paper with modeled fees. Not investment advice.

Args:
    asset: btc | eth | hype | sol | uni | zec | pine_btc
name: get_trading_decision
title: Trading decision
